pages.text: $(thing)Slime Moulds$()$(br2)Physarum is one cell that spreads toward food and keeps only the tubes that carry most: a network that solves shortest paths. Unlocks Physarum Cultures and cheap Network Maps.

$(thing)Insight$(): 110$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Mycology, Networks.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Mould Culture, 1 Network Map.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A tube of conductance D carries flow along a pressure drop p over a length L. Write the flow Q.
